sources.name: ZimLII (Zimbabwe Legal Information Institute, on the Laws.Africa Peachjam platform)
sources.licence: CC BY-NC 4.0, crediting ZimLII as the source (ZimLII terms of use s. 9, read from the Internet Archive capture 20261012174817 of https://zimlii.org/terms-of-use/)
sources.notes: Point-in-time expressions of each act, /akn/zw/act/<year>/<num>/eng@<date>, read from Internet Archive or Common Crawl captures only (ZimLII's terms s. 4 prohibit scraping; ZimLII's own pages were never requested). Capture timestamps and sha256s are pinned in sources.json.

sources.name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine
sources.licence: Archived copies of ZimLII pages; the content licence is ZimLII's
sources.notes: CDX API for discovery, then https://web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>id_/<original url> for the page bytes.

decisions: ZimLII acts: chosen by what the archive holds. Every expression ZimLII lists for the Criminal Law (Codification and Reform) Act (2017-03-23, 2019-02-20, 2022-03-11) and the Cyber and Data Protection Act (2022-03-11) has an archived copy.

ZimLII's terms of use (s. 4) prohibit scraping and bulk downloading; per the user's decision of 2026-10-28 ("scraping wayback is fair game, dont overdo it, we need this data and it is legal") only archived copies (Internet Archive id_ captures, Common Crawl) are read, only for the acts built, and the repository stays private. Content licence: CC BY-NC 4.0, crediting ZimLII (terms s. 9).
ai_use: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5, claude-opus-5-5) wrote the configuration and wrappers and chose the acts; the shared Peachjam adapter does the parsing. No model wrote, summarised or transformed legal text.
